test_safe_increment: test the numerics.safe_increment function increments values correctly and avoids overflow for all dtypes
test_safe_norm: test the numerics.safe_norm function computes gradients that are zero at zero input for various ord, axis, and keepdims combinations
test_safe_rms: test the numerics.safe_root_mean_squares function computes gradients that are zero at zero input with zero and non-zero min_rms
test_abs_sqr_hlo_equivalence: test that numerics.abs_sq generates equivalent HLO to jnp.square for real inputs and different HLO for complex inputs
test_safe_increment_exceptions: test that numerics.safe_increment raises ValueError for invalid dtypes like bool and complex64
